Senior Director, Software Engineering - AI

As a Capital One Senior Director of Software Engineering,  you’ll spearhead our AI initiatives, developing and managing elite technical teams to architect next-generation intelligent solutions. You will champion everything from enterprise LLM orchestration and generative AI pipelines integrated into web/mobile frontends, to high-throughput, low-latency microservices for real-time model inference. You'll bring deep expertise in scaling production-grade machine learning systems and traditional architectures.

At Capital One, we believe diversity of thought strengthens our ability to influence, collaborate and provide the most innovative solutions across organizational boundaries. You will foster a culture of engineering excellence and inclusivity, balancing technical depth with empowered team leadership. You will lead the way in building next-generation talent for Capital One Tech—mentoring managers and engineers, driving workforce strategy and actively recruiting top-tier talent.

Senior Directors are expected to lead through technical vision, operational rigor and strategic alignment. You will serve as a key owner for your domain's technical health, delivery velocity and system resilience. While shaping long-term technology strategy and platform roadmaps, you will inspire a culture of continuous learning, innovation and high-impact delivery across your organization.

You will:
- Lead, manage, and scale multiple high-performing teams of AI and machine learning focused software engineers to drive our AI initiatives.
- Mentor and guide the professional and technical development of engineers, cultivating deep expertise in MLOps, LLM architecture, and advanced data science practices.
- Partner with product managers and data scientists to translate desired intelligent application capabilities, model validation strategies, and evaluation frameworks into production-ready software.
- Continuously mature AI engineering practices, championing robust frameworks for model lineage, continuous training (CT), and secure, ethical AI deployment.
- Collaborate within and across Agile teams to architect, train, test, implement, and support scalable technical solutions across full-stack AI and distributed cloud technologies.
- Lead the technical craftsmanship, model reproducibility, low-latency availability, and enterprise-grade scalability of your intelligent solutions.

This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

- Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)
- At least 7 years of people management experience
- At least 9 years of experience in software engineering and solution architecture
- At least 9 years of experience in enterprise architecture and d

roles.description:
As a Principal AI Transformation Engineer , you will lead the strategic transformation and modernization of Citi’s Credit Risk Monitoring platforms—converting traditional UIs, manual analytical workflows, and legacy operational business processes into intelligent, AI-driven autonomous systems.

This pivotal role sits at the intersection of enterprise risk architecture and cutting-edge Generative AI. You will design, build, and deploy production-grade Agentic workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, custom LLM tools, prompt architectures, and intelligent conversational/generative interfaces that empower risk officers to monitor limit breaches, detect early warning indicators (EWIs), and orchestrate counterparty risk actions in real time.

This role requires deep hands-on engineering involvement (≥50% coding/prototyping), combining robust enterprise software engineering standards with state-of-the-art GenAI, Agentic orchestration frameworks, and system-level API/data integrations.

Key Responsibilities:

1. AI Stack Uplift, Agentic Systems & MCP Engineering (Hands-on ≥50%)
- Agentic Workflows & Multi-Agent Systems: Architect and build autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents capable of reasoning, decomposing complex credit risk tasks, querying risk databases, and executing end-to-end monitoring actions with human-in-the-loop governance.
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) & Tool Development: Design and implement robust MCP servers and secure API tool connectors that expose internal risk services, data stores, calculation engines, and third-party financial telemetry to LLMs and AI agent frameworks.
- Prompt Engineering & Context Optimization: Develop, benchmark, and maintain production-grade prompt pipelines, dynamic context retrieval mechanisms, system personas, few-shot strategies, and structured output schemas (e.g., JSON mode / Pydantic validation).
- Evaluation, Guardrails & Observability: Implement enterprise AI guardrails (evaluating hallucination, toxicity, faithfulness, and PII masking), latency/token cost optimizations, and comprehensive tracing/observability for all LLM calls and agent execution trees.

2. UI Modernization & Process Transformation
- Next-Gen AI User Experiences: Spearhead the transition away from monolithic, static grid/form UIs toward intelligent, assistive, and generative user interfaces (e.g., conversational risk copilots, automated narrative synthesis, dynamic workspace cards, and interactive visual dashboards).
- Workflow Automation & EWI Uplift: Re-engineer legacy manual review processes into streamlined, event-driven automated pipelines—automating Limit Monitoring alerts, sentiment analysis on financial news/filings, and synthesized risk commentary for Financial Institutions, Corporates, and Sovereign portfolios.
- Rapid Prototyping & Co-Creation: Partner directly with Credit Risk Analysts, Product Managers, and UX designers to rapidly build and validate Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), testing innovative AI capab

roles.description:
Are you interested in growing your career in Cyber Security?

Whether you are an application developer or researcher looking to make the switch into the challenging, yet rewarding, world of information security, or you are an elite white-hat hacker, Citi is the place for you. Our team of world class, talented individuals, who are passionate about security, put their skills to the test every day on a global scale. At Citi, you will be exposed to all sorts of technologies on an enterprise-scale, so hunger for knowledge and research is greatly appreciated and rewarded.

Technology is constantly evolving, and Citi is evolving with it by adopting the latest application frameworks, migrating to cloud-based technologies, and implementing Artificial Intelligence in numerous workflows across the enterprise. Citi’s application penetration testing team is at the forefront of testing and securing each of these solutions and you can make an impact on the next technology to be released.

This team specializes in conducting various types of penetration testing engagements (full end-to-end white-box and/or grey-box testing) against a variety of Citi owned or 3rd party SaaS applications (Web, Mobile, Thick Client, and APIs) leveraging a wide array of technologies from Artificial Intelligence, to Digital Assets, Blockchain, and more traditional application development frameworks. The primary goal would be to secure Citi, its customers, and clients by manually identifying, researching, validating, and exploiting application security weaknesses and misconfigurations.

Core responsibilities include:

-
- Plan, scope, and execute comprehensive penetration tests against blockchain networks, smart contracts, decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols, and digital asset custody systems.
- Perform manual and automated source code reviews of smart contracts written in Solidity, Rust, Go, or Vyper to identify logic flaws, reentrancy, front-running, flash loan vulnerabilities, and integer overflows.
- Act as a subject matter expert in offensive information security performing dynamic and manual security assessments on web technologies such as APIs, JavaScript Frameworks, Artificial Intelligence, and Distributed Ledger Technologies.
- Drive remediation by outlining a defense-in-depth approach to business stakeholders and providing strategic solutions to developers on effective preventive and detective security controls.
- Have strong technical writing and presentation skills to report and articulate the vulnerability assessment results to any audience.
- Contribute to the review of internal processes and activities and assist in identifying potential opportunities for improvement and automation.
- Conduct research into emerging attack vectors, zero-day exploits, and novel vulnerabilities unique to Web3 and digital asset ecosystems
- Must have or be willing to obtain Industry-accredited security certifications such as: BSCP, GWAPT, GPEN, OSCP, OSWE, CISSP, or other related certifi

roles.description:
**Chief Technology Officer**

**Organization:** National Nonprofit Organization  
**Reports To:** Chief Executive Officer  
**Department:** Technology  
**Work Location:** Remote  
**Employment Status:** Regular, Full-Time, Exempt  
**Position Level:** Executive / Senior Leadership  
**Salary Range:** $225,000–$250,000 annually

**ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION**

We are a national nonprofit organization committed to advancing our mission through innovative programs, strategic partnerships, and technology-enabled services. We work with diverse stakeholders across the country to deliver programs, strengthen operations, and achieve meaningful outcomes.

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Chief Technology Officer to lead our technology function, strengthen operational performance, and guide the continued evolution of our technology infrastructure and digital platforms.

This is an opportunity to join our executive leadership team and play a critical role in shaping our technology strategy, strengthening our systems and capabilities, and ensuring technology supports our organizational mission and long-term priorities.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) serves as our senior technology executive and technical authority, with overall accountability for enterprise technology strategy, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data governance, and technology delivery.

This is a hands-on executive leadership role requiring a combination of deep technical expertise, strategic thinking, business acumen, and operational leadership. The CTO directly supervises the technology team, provides technical direction, oversees production changes, and ensures the reliability, security, and performance of our critical systems.

The position combines responsibilities often distributed across an engineering manager, vice president of engineering, and chief technology officer. The successful candidate must be equally comfortable making complex technical decisions, leading a multidisciplinary team, developing long-term technology strategies, and advising executive leadership on investments, operational risks, and organizational priorities.

The CTO leads a team of employees and contractors responsible for enterprise applications, digital platforms, data and reporting systems, cloud infrastructure, and internal IT operations. The role carries direct accountability for the availability, performance, security, and continued modernization of business-critical systems.

**POSITION DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Executive Leadership and Accountability:** Serve as a member of the executive leadership team, advising the CEO and senior leaders on technology strategy, investments, risks, and opportunities. Translate complex technical matters into business implications and contribute to organizational strategy, resource planning, and executive and board discussions.
* **Team Leadership and Supervision:** Directly supervise engineering, analysis, and IT staff

Director, Technical Program Management (Remote-Eligible)

Do you love driving complex technical initiatives and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Technical Program Managers who are passionate about marrying technology with business strategy to join our team. As a Technical Program Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving major technical transformations and scaling platform capabilities across Capital One.

What You’ll Do:
As a Director of Technical Program Management (TPM), we’re looking for someone that can help us lead programs that deliver on critical business goals and build large scale products & platforms that will help Capital One customers have incredible experiences.

In addition to the technical program, you will also work to pave the way for an expanding TPM discipline within the team, by leveraging your industry knowledge and experience to teach the organization what a great TPM can achieve.
- Contribute to the organization’s TPM / Delivery strategy: establish operating mechanisms, maturity models, and tooling that scale across portfolios
- Drive development of and alignment on program roadmap anchored in business objectives, definition of done, technical solutions, and sequencing of dependencies
- Lead cross-platform technical investment planning and ensure architectural alignment toward long-term platform convergence and reuse
- Serve as an executive-level escalation point for program risks, influencing technology leaders to make data-driven tradeoffs between speed, cost and resiliency
- Ensure definition of measurable outcomes of platform success (availability, scalability, cost efficiency, developer velocity) and ensure delivery accountability across multiple engineering teams

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in a technical field
- At least 7 years of experience managing technical programs

Preferred Qualifications:
- 7+ years of experience designing and building solutions using distributed computing  or service oriented architecture (SOA)
- 3+ years of experience in building distributed systems & highly available services using cloud computing services / architecture - preferably using AWS
- 3+ years experience building highly scalable products & platforms
- 3+ years of experience with Agile delivery
- 3+ years years experience delivering large and complex programs - where you contribute to the business or technical vision, collaborate with large cross-functional teams, secure commitments on deliverables and unblock teams to land business impact
- Experience in building systems & solutions within a highly regulated environment
- MBA

**About Connct**

Connct is an AI companion web app (desktop and mobile) for adults. Users create their own AI companion and build an evolving relationship with it through chat, voice calls, images and short videos. We operate in the same space as Replika, Candy AI and OurDream AI.

Our ambition is clear: to build an almost fully autonomous AI company, where agents run most of the engineering, operations and product work, and a small human team steers them.

We launched the product one month ago, after a beta testing phase. The product is ready and live with paying users, but it has to keep improving every week: constant improvement is what drives retention, and retention is what drives profitability.

**The role**

You are the architect of our almost fully autonomous AI company. You own all of Connct's technology and production, end to end, and you run it with an army of AI agents that you design, deploy and keep running on top of our stack.

At Connct, agents are not a side tool. They build, test, review, monitor and operate a large part of the product. You design them, run them and answer for everything they ship to production. You ship what is prioritized, prove it works in production, catch failures before users do, and own everything that goes live.

You work closely with our Head of Product, who owns product decisions and data analysis.

**What you own**

* Code, reviews, releases and A/B test setup
* Production monitoring, alerts and incidents
* Vendors: AI models, media generation API, payments, email, voice calls
* Security, minor protection and compliance
* Data and tracking reliability
* Tech costs, tooling and technical proposals
* Integration of pricing and offers, and tracking for paid ads
* You are consulted on the priority roadmap (dates), vision, budget and product testing.

**What you'll do**

* Agentic AI system: toward an almost fully autonomous companyDesign, deploy and run the army of agents that build, test, review, monitor and operate theproduct
* Make the company more autonomous every month: find what is still done by hand, in tech and beyond (product, ops, support), and hand it to agents
* Keep the agent fleet reliable in production: orchestration, task routing, memory and context, monitoring, failure recovery
* Set up evals, review, sandboxing and cost control for every agent
* Run daily automated evaluations of chat, media and voice calls
* Document the agent team: roles, guardrails and cost per agent

**Shipping and code quality**

* Ship improvements every week across the web app, the media lab, voice calls and media generation: a product that keeps getting better is how we win on retention and profitability
* Make CI mandatory to merge: no direct changes to main, every PR reviewed
* Review all code before production, whether written by freelancers, agencies or agents
* Safe releases: staging, feature flags, fast rollback, tested migrations
* Verify every delivery in production before announcing it

Ever since our first credit card customer in 1994, Capital One has recognized that technology and data can enable even large companies to be innovative and personalized. As one of the first large enterprises to go all-in on the public cloud, Capital One built cloud and data management tools that didn’t exist in the marketplace to operate at scale. **Imagine yourself…**
=====================

* Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you.
* Thriving in a supportive team environment that inspires you to strive for excellence.

Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources and building rewarding careers along the way.

**The Opportunity**
===================

Veralto (www.veralto.com / NYSE: VLTO) is a global leader in essential technology solutions, comprising a portfolio of international businesses. We’re big enough to offer real resources and global reach, and focused enough that what you do here genuinely matters.

The Vice President, AI is a remote role based in the United States and reports directly to the Senior Vice President and Chief Digital and Information Officer (CDIO). The jobholder will 1) set the enterprise AI roadmap and a single process to intake, score, and prioritize AI initiatives across operating companies; 2) build and lead the corporate AI team of data scientists and machine learning engineers that delivers the highest-value use cases; and 3) put in place the tools, governance, and controls that keep AI use secure, visible, and measurable.

This position builds the corporate AI team in phases as the mandate grows, using external consulting partners to start work quickly while the team is hired. It works closely with the Veralto Enterprise System (VES) team, Human Resources, and the operating companies, and offers stimulating challenges, personal growth, and the opportunity to build something substantial.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**AI Strategy & Portfolio Prioritization**
------------------------------------------

* Define and drive the enterprise AI roadmap with the CDIO and senior leadership, using a common framework of AI layers (universal, functional, domain, and governance and security) mapped to Veralto’s value levers (commercial acceleration, product innovation, time to market, and operational efficiency).
* Establish one intake and scoring process for AI initiatives across operating companies, requiring a named owner, KPI, baseline, cost, and timing, and prioritize by business impact, technical feasibility, AI-versus-human fit, and risk.
* Sequence the portfolio: scale functional use cases first, then AI-enabled VES tools, then domain AI embedded in Veralto’s products and solutions.
* Identify and incubate AI-enabled product and service opportunities with the operating companies, taking ideas from ideation through risk burn-down to market and new areas of revenue.

Are you drawn to deciding how technology should work across a complex environment with many players? Can you see yourself setting the direction that takes the School’s technology toward an AI-enabled future? If so, consider joining our team! The Managing Director, Technology Strategy & IT Architecture will set the technology direction and architecture on which the School depends, supporting HBS’s mission to educate leaders who make a difference in the world.

Videa is the most adopted dental AI platform, used by 90,000 clinicians. Our vision is to be the first company to diagnose a billion people.

We connect diagnostics, documentation and daily operations in one platform. Our products span FDA-cleared computer vision, an ambient dental scribe, voice perio charting, and tools that help practices manage performance and claims.

AI is the foundation of that work. Clinicians make the decisions; our models help them catch disease earlier, understand findings and get documentation done without adding steps to their day. This role leads the team building those capabilities.

AI is changing data center infrastructure faster than any cycle before it, and memory is at the center of that change. As Director of Data Center Market Intelligence, reporting to the Sr. Director of Market Intelligence, you will lead the team that turns data center market dynamics into clear, reliable memory demand signals for DRAM, HBM and NAND/eSSD. You will be leadership's go-to source for weekly market sensing, build trusted relationships across the data center ecosystem, and work across Product Marketing, Sales, Product Planning and global headquarters teams. Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. We are hiring a Director, Security Engineering to lead Lyra Health's security engineering and operations function. Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. **Job Description**

**About Aspire NorCal**

Founded in 1998, Aspire Public Schools has served scholars and communities across California for nearly three decades. With Aspire Los Angeles transitioning into an independent organization, the Bay Area and Central Valley regions are coming together to form Aspire NorCal, operating 22 schools serving approximately 10,000 scholars across Northern California (Oakland, Richmond, East Palo Alto, Sacramento, Stockton, Modesto, and Ceres).

This evolution comes at an important moment for Aspire. Changes in California’s funding, policy, enrollment, and operating environment have created an opportunity to rethink how the organization supports its schools and scholars in its next chapter. The formation of Aspire NorCal creates an opportunity to strengthen support for schools across teams previously organized by geography, improve the consistency and effectiveness of school support, and create clear accountability systems for organizational and scholar outcomes. The new model will require the organization to balance greater coherence across Aspire NorCal with responsiveness to the different communities and contexts of its schools.

Aspire NorCal enters this transition with a long-standing mission focused on post-secondary success and a deep commitment to educational equity, along with decades of institutional knowledge across its schools and teams. Preserving those strengths while building Aspire NorCal as a unified region will be central to the work ahead.

**About the AI, Data & Systems Enablement team**

The Data & Systems team exists to give principals, teachers, and teammates their time back. We are responsible for Aspire NorCal's data and the key software systems that cross departments, and we measure ourselves by the experience of the people we serve: a principal gets a trusted answer in minutes if not seconds, a new hire is entered once, and no one navigates five systems to do one job. We use AI to get there, and we set the policy and training that keep it useful and appropriately safe. The team is made up of an Enablement team that builds the shared foundation, plus pods that each serve a customer group: School Operations & Principals, Academics & Teachers, and People & Resources. ------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

This is the operational front door of the platform; how quickly a referral becomes a scheduled visit drives both patient access and billable capacity utilization.

You’ll report to the Chief Technology Officer and partner with a Senior Product Director already in seat and a Stream Scrum Master to set direction for the organization.

Your applications already run on independent, modern deploy pipelines, separate from the company’s legacy core platform. But the data they write ultimately lands in that same shared, legacy database and services layer — single-tenant per agency, the same system every other application on the platform depends on. Operating skillfully inside that constraint, not around it, is a permanent part of this role, not a modernization initiative this seat owns.

**Hybrid:** This hybrid role is based in **Dallas, TX** and requires the person resides in the Dallas area.

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the role
Cloudflare is hiring a Head of Zero Day Engineering to build and lead the team that turns newly discovered vulnerabilities into verified protection—for Cloudflare and its customers.
High-priority vulnerabilities rarely fit within one team’s boundaries. A fix may require kernel expertise, changes across software dependencies and trust stores, fleet-wide deployment, customer-facing WAF protections, and investigation of prior exploitation. You will bring those efforts together, with clear ownership from initial disclosure through verified remediation.
This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. You will recruit the team, establish its operating model, and build the tooling that makes response faster and more reliable. You will combine experienced human judgment with carefully evaluated AI-assisted workflows—not automate away accountability.
What you’ll do
Build and lead the team
- Establish Zero Day Engineering’s charter, priorities, operating model, and partnerships across Cloudflare.
- Recruit, develop, and lead engineers spanning vulnerability response, exposure analysis, mitigation, patching, artifact provenance, release coordination, and automation.
- Build a sustainable incident-command rotation, clear escalation paths, and effective handoffs across teams and time zones.
- Create a culture of technical depth, calm execution, blameless learning, and shared accountability.
Own vulnerability response end to end

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

The National Cancer Institute (NCI) is seeking an innovative leader to serve as the Director, Center for Biomedical Informatics and Information Technology (CBIIT), located in the Office of the Director (OD), National Cancer Institute (NCI), National Institutes of Health (NIH). The Director, CBIIT is classified under the Title 42 hiring mechanism and is equivalent to an extramural Program Division Director position. The position reports to the NCI Deputy Director for Data Science and Strategy. The Director, CBIIT leads the federal government components in the cancer research IT and informatics enterprise. In this capacity, the CBIIT Director delivers executive and managerial leadership and oversight for NCI-wide cybersecurity, use of IT, alignment with federal IT policies and requirements. The position also provides data science and informatics vision to NCI data science, informatics, and computational investments, including advancing the use of artificial intelligence across the research and operational spectrum. The Director, CBIIT oversees the implementation of the NCI cancer data ecosystem, the function of the NCI CIO, and coordinates data science and research data access for NCI at a national level.
  
Duties
  
  
The Director, CBIIT, is responsible for oversight of critical NCI information systems including systems that support clinical trials data, cancer data standards, multimodal cancer research data, and NCI grants information and other key business systems. The position manages a budget of approximately $240 million dollars, overseeing a federal workforce of approximately 90 people and more than 600 contractors engaged in providing IT, biomedical research informatics and software infrastructure and services to NCI. The CBIIT Director also participates in the scientific leadership of NCI and in NCI research initiatives and represents NCI with relevant national and international research communities. The CBIIT Director will also build strong working relationships that foster a strong, vibrant cohesive team across NCI.

You will lead the enterprise architecture strategy and governance framework, ensuring technology investments, platforms, applications, integrations, data, infrastructure, cloud services, and security architecture align with business strategy and enterprise standards. Reporting to the Vice President, Global Technology Solutions, you will be a senior technology advisor to business and GTS leaders, developing target-state architectures and multiyear roadmaps and overseeing major investments and transformation initiatives. At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we're revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

**About the Role:**

The Director of the Security Operations Center owns detection, response, and threat hunting across our production, corporate, and cloud environments. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will set the direction of the SOC in line with the CISO's security strategy and run a team of senior technical professionals day to day. When an incident calls for it, you will step in personally and lead the investigation and response. You report directly to the CISO and act as their operational partner, so the CISO always has an accurate picture of threats, exposure, and our ability to respond.

**What you will do:**

* Turn the CISO's security strategy into a SOC roadmap, prioritize where detection and response investment goes, and show measurable progress against it.
* Own the end-to-end detection and response lifecycle, from telemetry collection through detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and corrective action.
* Act as incident commander for the highest-severity events. Get hands-on in the investigation, analyze logs, endpoint, network, identity, and cloud telemetry yourself, and make containment decisions under pressure.
* Build, lead, and develop a team of incident response, detection, and threat hunting engineers. Set a high technical bar, coach people through hard investigations, and hold the team accountable for quality and follow-through.
* Hold your ground on technical and risk decisions with engineering, product, IT, and executive stakeholders. Push back with evidence when a decision increases exposure, and escalate clearly when needed.
* Design and evolve the SOC architecture, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, identity, and cloud detection tooling. Decide what to build, what to buy, and what to retire.
* Drive an automation-first operating model that cuts manual triage, shortens time to detect and contain, and lets the team scale without adding headcount in step with the environment.
* Establish full telemetry coverage across the Compass platform, including acquired environments, so that every critical asset produces attributable, correlated events.
* Lead a threat-informed defense program. Use adversary behavior, threat intelligence, and hunting results to drive detection engineering and active defense capabilities.
* Own the incident response plan, severity definitions, escalation paths, and on-call model. Run realistic tabletop and live-fire exercises that include technical teams and executives.
* Run blameless post-incident reviews and make sure corrective actions have an identified owner, a deadline, and verified completion.
* Define and report the operational metrics that matter, such as coverage, detection fidelity, dwell time,

At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

**About the Role:**

The Director of the Security Operations Center owns detection, response, and threat hunting across our production, corporate, and cloud environments. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will set the direction of the SOC in line with the CISO's security strategy and run a team of senior technical professionals day to day. When an incident calls for it, you will step in personally and lead the investigation and response. You report directly to the CISO and act as their operational partner, so the CISO always has an accurate picture of threats, exposure, and our ability to respond.

**What you will do:**

* Turn the CISO's security strategy into a SOC roadmap, prioritize where detection and response investment goes, and show measurable progress against it.
* Own the end-to-end detection and response lifecycle, from telemetry collection through detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and corrective action.
* Act as incident commander for the highest-severity events. Get hands-on in the investigation, analyze logs, endpoint, network, identity, and cloud telemetry yourself, and make containment decisions under pressure.
* Build, lead, and develop a team of incident response, detection, and threat hunting engineers. Set a high technical bar, coach people through hard investigations, and hold the team accountable for quality and follow-through.
* Hold your ground on technical and risk decisions with engineering, product, IT, and executive stakeholders. Push back with evidence when a decision increases exposure, and escalate clearly when needed.
* Design and evolve the SOC architecture, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, identity, and cloud detection tooling. Decide what to build, what to buy, and what to retire.
* Drive an automation-first operating model that cuts manual triage, shortens time to detect and contain, and lets the team scale without adding headcount in step with the environment.
* Establish full telemetry coverage across the Compass platform, including acquired environments, so that every critical asset produces attributable, correlated events.
* Lead a threat-informed defense program. Use adversary behavior, threat intelligence, and hunting results to drive detection engineering and active defense capabilities.
* Own the incident response plan, severity definitions, escalation paths, and on-call model. Run realistic tabletop and live-fire exercises that include technical teams and executives.
* Run blameless post-incident reviews and make sure corrective actions have an identified owner, a deadline, and verified completion.
* Define and report the operational metrics that matter, such as coverage, detection fidelity, dwell time,

Fitch Group is seeking a Director, Solutions Architecture based in our New York office, reporting to the Lead Enterprise Architect for the Fitch Group line of business you support.

You'll partner directly with the teams building technology across your line of business, helping them design solutions, navigate architecture standards, and build with confidence. This multi-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow.

 

Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy-to-use, AI-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers.

 

Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long.

**The Opportunity**

This is a greenfield role. You'll build a product management practice, shape an entirely new category at AWS, and establish the engagement model that delivers delightful outcomes enabling customers to transform themselves.

**The Role**

As the Director of Product Management — Forward Deployed Engineering will lead product management for FDE, building and leading the PM team that owns the end-to-end product lifecycle from customer engagement through production delivery through optimization and self-sufficiency. Your product managers embed directly inside enterprise customers — defining outcomes, writing specs, working hand-in-hand with engineering to ship production systems — and every engagement feeds back into AWS services and an underlying platform that makes the next one faster.

This is not a traditional AWS Product Management role. FDE product managers are field-facing: they live inside delivery, sit with customers, and turn engagement learnings into compounding platform value. You are the "CEO of the customer problem" — responsible for the *why* and *what*, while engineering owns the *how*.

Key job responsibilities

You own the customer outcomes. Your teams operate inside customer environments under real constraints and ambitious timelines — regulated data, brownfield infrastructure, multi-stakeholder governance. You lead the customer engagement strategy from the product side: define what a great pod PM does, allocate PM talent across engagements, ensure pods are solving the right problems, and hold executive customer relationships at the CIO/CTO level built on trust earned through delivered outcomes.

### Product & Platform Influence

You see what breaks  across deployments and turn that into product direction. You influence AWS service roadmap from a position of earned authority because you've lived the deployment pain firsthand, and identify when custom pod work should graduate into platform primitives or native service capabilities.

You shape the FDE engagement model: how we scope, what we deliver, what we price, what we leave behind.

### Industry Practice & Productization

You build the domain expertise that compounds. Your teams develop industry-specific accelerators, reference architectures, and blueprints that generate pipeline for the next customer in your vertical. You define the use cases that feed qualification, pricing, and pod composition. You measure what matters: asset reuse rate, time-to-value, engagement velocity

### Go-to-Market Partnership

You partner with sales, specialists, and marketing to define pricing, packaging, and positioning. You own the commercial model for FDE engagements — how we price outcomes, what the customer buys, and how we demonstrate ROI. You build pipeline through customer stories, reference architectures

Build AI That Could Help Transform the Future of Medicine

Frontier AI is changing what’s possible in science, and few places let you apply it to a problem as consequential as human health. Pfizer is one of them. We have decades of world-class biology and chemistry, rich biomedical data and the global reach to get medicines to patients. We are pairing them with the newest advances in AI and we are doing it along with the world’s leaders in building medicine.

At Pfizer, we believe the next generation of scientific breakthroughs will be powered by advances in artificial intelligence. From foundation models and multimodal learning to biological reasoning and agentic systems, AI has the potential to fundamentally change how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines to patients.  You will help create the scientific foundations behind that future at Pfizer.

We are not looking for one clever model for one clever problem or applying existing models to a single problem. You will develop, extend, and rigorously evaluate advanced AI methods that generate new scientific insights, accelerate experimentation, and enable better decision-making across the drug discovery and development lifecycle. We are building AI that compounds. A method, benchmark or model that works in one disease area should become a foundation that can impact across oncology, immunology/inflammation, internal medicine, vaccines and beyond. You’ll design for that!

Working alongside world-class AI researchers, computational biologists, engineers, and domain experts, you'll tackle some of the most challenging and meaningful problems in healthcare while building technology that has the potential to impact millions of patients worldwide.

Why This Role Is Different
Own Meaningful Scientific Challenges: You will own defined model components, benchmarks, evaluation frameworks, and research workflows that directly influence how AI is applied across Pfizer's R&D organization. You'll build the models, and you'll also decide whether they create real scientific value and whether that value holds up in new contexts.

Where you will push the frontier:  You'll contribute to cutting-edge research across areas such as:

-
- Foundation models and representation learning.
- Multimodal learning across molecular, imaging, clinical and omics data
- Agentic AI and scientific reasoning systems
- Biological Sequence & Structure Modeling
- Graph learning and knowledge graphs
- Clinical & Real-World Data Modeling
- Uncertainty-Aware AI, causal ML and Interpretability

Create Impact Beyond Research Papers
Publishing matters, but the goal is bigger. Your work will help scientists understand disease biology, prioritize experiments, and evaluate therapeutic opportunities across the portfolio. It will speed up medicines for the people waiting on them.

Work at the frontier, with the people who can ship it to patients.

The VP of Enterprise Data Strategy is ATI’s enterprise owner of data as a strategic asset. Reporting jointly to the Chief Operating Officer and the Chief Information Officer, this executive connects IT’s data engineering and platform teams with the analytics and reporting teams in the business, and is accountable for turning today’s fragmented data landscape into a single, governed, well-defined enterprise data foundation.

Agentio enables marketers to buy creator led ads as easily and scalably as Meta or Google ads—automating sourcing, pricing, contracting, delivery, and measurement with AI—so work that took months now happens in minutes.

We’re on a mission to transform a $800B digital ad ecosystem by shifting digital ad spend into the hands of creators. That means better outcomes for marketers and enabling creators to live off their work—finally being paid in proportion to the value they create. That shift is accelerating: Unilever’s CEO has said the company will move roughly half of its ad budget into social and creators—Unilever is among the world’s largest advertisers, spending around $9–10B annually. As these dollars move, they need performance-grade pipes; Agentio is how those dollars flow to creators with the speed, control, and measurement marketers expect. We enable brands like Uber, DoorDash, and Bombas to run creator campaigns with the same rigor, control, and accountability as their core performance channels.

Agentio has raised $56M at a $340M valuation, including a Series B led by Forerunner https://techcrunch.com/2025/11/18/agentio-secures-40-million-from-forerunner-as-it-scales-its-creator-marketplace-beyond-youtube/ that followed our Series A within a calendar year. Backed by Benchmark, Craft, and AlleyCorp. Named to Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, 2025 https://www.forbes.com/sites/amyfeldman/2025/08/12/next-billion-dollar-startups-2025/. Named to Inc.’s Best Places to Work 2026, one of 10 companies nationally recognized in the “On the Rise: 0–4 Years in Business” category.

An $800B market. A once-in-a-generation technology shift. This is the moment. This is the team. Come build something generational with us.

We’re looking for a Head of Platform and Channel Partnerships to help solidify Agentio’s critical role in the marketing ecosystem and then build the partnerships that enable Agentio to quickly tip the market. Our goal is to be an integral part of the stack for every marketer, at every level. You’ll own the partnerships that make that happen.

That covers platform partnerships, channel sales partnerships, measurement partnerships, and product partnership opportunities. You’ll think strategically about how the ecosystem fits together, where Agentio creates value for partners and where partners create value for us, and how we can prioritize our GTM and product investments. Then you’ll go source the deals, shape them, and close them, and often times do so alongside our CEO, CTO, and leadership team.

This is a builder’s seat. We’re not looking for someone who manages a portfolio of existing relationships with a big team and a bigger budget. You’ll be setting the partnership strategy from the ground up, with scrappy resources, and you’ll be the first person at Agentio to own this full time. About the Role
The Director, Product Engineering will lead the team responsible for our care management applications and the vendor integrations that connect them to the rest of the care ecosystem, including EHRs, scheduling systems, and other external health systems. The Director will manage a team of engineering managers and senior engineers, while serving as a hands-on technical leader who sets the standard through their own contributions to the code.
This role sits at the center of our next phase of AI transformation. We’ve embraced AI to empower our engineers, using Cursor and agentic tooling for triage, automated updates, and faster feature delivery. Now we’re moving toward fully agentic development, where AI agents take work from ticket through product requirements, engineering design, and implementation within well-defined guardrails. The Director will define the strategy, priorities, validation, and review practices that make this possible, shifting our product engineers from building individual features to designing the systems and guardrails that let agents do that work safely and reliably.
The Director will partner closely with product, design, clinical operations, data science, and data platform teams to deliver technology that drives tech-enabled care for underserved populations. We’re looking for a leader who is equally comfortable growing people and writing code, and who is deeply curious about, and energized by, what AI-first engineering makes possible.

- Lead and mentor a team of engineering managers and senior technical leaders, setting clear, measurable goals and building a strong bench of future leaders
- Own the strategy, roadmap, and long-term health of our care management applications and the vendor integrations that connect to them (EHR, scheduling, and other external systems)
- Define and drive our path to fully agentic development workflows, where agents move work from ticket to product requirements doc, to engineering design doc, to shipped code
- Design and maintain the guardrails, validation processes, and review personas that allow agents to safely run the full development lifecycle
- Shift the team’s focus from hand-building features to designing, evaluating, and improving the agentic systems that build them
- Evaluate and adopt AI and agent tooling (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Mastra, and similar agent frameworks) and establish best practices across the organization
- Remain a hands-on contributor, writing and reviewing well-tested, scalable code to maintain technical credibility and unblock critical initiatives

Summary
  
Fairbanks Morse Defense builds and supports the engines, power systems, and mechanical systems that keep Navy and Coast Guard ships underway. Our technology organization develops the next generation of those products, modernizes the equipment already in the fleet, and guides where FMD invests across its product lines.
  
We are hiring a Director of Technology to lead that organization. You will own three things: technology development and internal R&D investment, the retrofit and upgrade business that modernizes in-service engines and systems, and product portfolio management across FMD. You will set the technology roadmap, lead the engineering and product teams that deliver it, and report to the Sr. Vice President of Strategic Projects.
  
This role is remote, leading a team out of Beloit Wisconsin, with approximately 35% travel to FMD facilities, customer sites, shipyards, and test sites.
  
Why This Role
  

* The full technology lifecycle. You own products from early R&D through military qualification, fielding, and in-service upgrade.
* A fleet that needs modernizing. FMD engines and systems are installed across the Navy, Coast Guard, and Military Sealift Command fleets. Your retrofit and upgrade programs extend their service life, improve readiness, and solve obsolescence.
* A portfolio view across FMD. You see every product line in the company and shape where FMD invests, and sustains.
* Customer and executive access. You work directly with Navy technical authorities, program offices, and research sponsors, and with FMD’s executive team and business leaders.
* A mission that matters. Your products help keep global naval and coast guard vessels powered, ready, and supported.

The Vice President, Enterprise Strategy & Transformation is a senior enterprise leader responsible for translating ADI’s strategy into an integrated transformation agenda and ensuring the business realises measurable customer, operational and financial value from its most important strategic priorities.

Reporting to the President and CEO, this leader will work across the executive leadership team to prioritise and sequence transformation activity, guide investment and capacity decisions, and establish the governance and value-realisation disciplines required to deliver ADI’s strategy. The role will lead the enterprise transformation organisation and provide an integrated view across commercial, customer, operational, process, data, technology, productivity and organisational priorities.

JOB DUTIES:
- Define and lead ADI’s multi-year enterprise transformation agenda, translating strategic priorities into a clear portfolio of initiatives, required capabilities, investments and measurable outcomes.
- Partner with the CEO and executive leadership team on strategic planning, roadmaps and priorities, translating strategic choices into the operating model, capability, technology, process and organisational changes required to deliver ADI’s long-term objectives.
- Lead the enterprise transformation organisation and governance model, establishing clear sponsorship, ownership, decision rights and accountability across major programmes.
- Maintain an integrated view of transformation priorities, milestones, dependencies, resources and organisational capacity, driving decisions and trade-offs when competing priorities or constraints put outcomes at risk.
- Identify and advance transformation opportunities that improve profitable growth, customer experience, commercial effectiveness, margin, productivity, cost-to-serve, supply-chain performance and organisational scalability.
- Partner with Technology and business leaders to ensure technology investments are connected to business-process redesign, data, organisational capabilities, adoption and measurable business value.
- Establish clear expectations for change and adoption, partnering with the People Team, Communications, executive sponsors and business leaders to ensure major initiatives are successfully implemented and sustained.
- Partner with Finance and initiative owners to establish credible baselines, validate expected benefits and track customer, operational, financial and adoption outcomes through value realisation.
- Integrate transformation priorities and performance into ADI’s existing management operating system and business-review processes, providing clear, fact-based reporting and recommendations to the executive leadership team and, where appropriate, the Board.
- Serve as a trusted strategy and transformation advisor to the CEO and executive leadership team, constructively challenging assumptions and helping leaders make enterprise-level decisions when priorities compete.

Courier Health is on a mission to solve one of the biggest and most meaningful opportunities in healthcare: reinvent how people living with chronic and rare diseases are supported.

We are building the future of patient engagement for life sciences companies. Our software is leveraged by biopharma companies to support patients in their complex journey from diagnosis to initiating and remaining on therapy to achieve optimal health outcomes.

**Come Build with Us**
----------------------

We're an NYC-based team that believes culture, craft, and customer obsession go hand in hand. We show up for each other the same way we show up for the people we serve. We're an office-first company that values in-person collaboration 4 days per week because we believe the best work happens when you can collaborate and brainstorm together in the same room. If that sounds like your kind of place, we think you'll love it here.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Courier Health is at an inflection point. We exist to get patients faster, better access to life-saving therapies. Patients trust us with their health information, and the pharma companies we serve trust us to protect it. That trust is what lets the mission scale. This role owns that.

As Director of Security, you will report to the CTO and set direction for security across three surfaces: the Courier platform and the AI agents running on it, how our engineers build that platform, and how we run the company. IT Operations reports through you, and you will set the direction for security architecture across Courier.

This is a build job. We are putting AI agents into patient workflows that touch PHI, and the playbook for securing that is still being written. You will write it. And you will use agents to run a security program that covers far more ground than its headcount suggests.

**What You'll Build**
---------------------

**A platform that earns a pharma security team's trust.** You will set the direction for security architecture of the Courier platform and our AI agents, threat-modeling agent workflows for prompt injection, tool and permission boundaries, and data leakage before they ship. When customers run security reviews, questionnaires, RFPs, and audits, you are the voice across the table. Our platform's security should be a reason they choose us.

**An engineering org that ships securely by default.** Threat modeling, CI guardrails, secrets management, dependency and infrastructure scanning, and a security champions program. You set the direction, and the secure path becomes the easy one. You will hold Courier's own AI use to the same standard: what coding agents and AI tools can access and commit, with frameworks like NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001 treated as engineering requirements, not paperwork.
